name: gatorkeys
label: Oct 26, 1984 (Gator Keys)
notes: The Gator Keys 0.3.5 (a map for GTA Vice City Nextgen Edition): its own pieces only; the 111 Vice City palms it places from VCNE's files are not in it. Textures VCNE supplied stand in from the island's own (substitutes) or flat (stand_ins).

collision.notes: v1.7.31: the mod's collision is its render meshes (293,000 triangles); thin rails, lamp heads, litter and small bits have none here, nor gtrpalm_col (palm trunks, 45 of its 113 under palms this set does not have); the deep sea floor goes.

tiles.notes: v1.7.32: models over 100 m in radius (the terrain, roads, rocks, rails, lamps, small bits) cut into tiles of 150 m; their render triangles wholly over 3 m under the sea dropped (as the collision's are: the few huge deep-slope triangles went with them)

plant_notes: v1.7.37: the palm clusters' palms (gtrpalm0-19) each moved to the ground under it (plant.py: the mod places a cluster of up to 20 palms by its middle, so those on a slope's low side stood buried, those on the high side on their roots), with a trunk of collision each in place of the mod's gtrpalm_col.

life.notes: v1.7.37: the mod's 36 car generators (sports cars at the hotel, a sailboat, a helicopter on the pad; Vice City's sparrow as the game's maverick); tourists, joggers and the resort's staff about the player; the weather EXTRASUNNY (0); the trainer's own surf, breeze, gulls and insects.
